items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Look at Howard Hughes. Did he take a Brink truck behind him to his grave with all his money?

ctx.x: I'm glad that I'm not materialistic, that material things don't destroy my life. I only need so much to live off of, don't need no more. And you think I (inaudible). You think I'd let it worry me. Just another (inaudible) break down try to get another one, same difference

with life. If I'm going to horde money, then what am I going to do when I die, leaving it for everybody to fight over. Look at Howard Hughes. Did he take a Brink truck behind him to his grave with all his money? And they're still fighting over it.

You know, it's pathetic to have all that money and never live. Now, I don't want nothing like that in my life. Just give me enough to live off of. I know things are going up, but I just want enough that'll run (inaudible) to pay my expenses and things. And if I'm not able to work, have a rainy day, have a little in reserve that I can take from and still live. Now, what more you want?
